description: September 8 birthday meaning: Virgo decan 2, birthday number 8, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a September 8 birthday falls in Virgo, in the second decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Saturn as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 8. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Virgo is mutable and earth.

sections.heading: The September 8 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Halfway through Virgo, at about fifteen degrees, the Sun of September 8 sits squarely in the second decan, where Saturn lends ambition a long horizon. The birthday number 8 concerns authority, resources and results. Together they suggest a manager in the best sense, someone who earns trust through accurate figures and kept promises rather than charisma, and who builds influence slowly.

Astronomically, September 8 puts the Sun near 15° Virgo in most years, inside the second ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Saturn. From 10 to 19 degrees of Virgo the sub-ruler is Saturn, which also rules Capricorn. Early-to-mid September birthdays therefore combine Virgo's attention to detail with a serious, long-term sense of responsibility. These natives are frequently described as dependable, disciplined and drawn to work that matters over years rather than weeks. They may carry duties others have dropped, without complaining about it. Saturn can also bring self-doubt and a reluctance to celebrate small wins. Allowing progress to count before it is complete often helps this decan enjoy the sturdy structures it is so good at building.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for September 8
paragraphs: A birthday on the 8th gives a birthday number of 8 with nothing to reduce. In numerology the day of birth works as a supporting number, a practical aptitude that colours the Life Path. The 8, drawn as two stacked loops, is traditionally linked with balance between the material and inner worlds, and with authority, organisation and ambition. People born on the 8th are often seen as capable managers of money, time and teams. They may also be hard on themselves when results lag. Generosity with the influence they build is commonly regarded as the 8's best expression.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a September 8 birthday gives Life Path 9 for 1990, 1 for 2000, 2 for 2010 and 3 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous September 8 birthdays
paragraphs: A September birthday arrives at the turn into autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of new terms and gathering in, and at the start of spring in the southern. Virgo occupies most of the month, with Libra taking over around September 22 or 23, near the equinox. September is month 9 in numerology, the number of completion, compassion and a broad, humanitarian outlook. September 8 is the 251st day of the year (252nd in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Libra, is usually complete within 15 days, by September 23.

By September 8 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a September 8 birthday are Antonín Dvořák (1841), Bernie Sanders (1941) and Frédéric Mistral (1830).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is September 8?
faq.answer: September 8 is Virgo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Virgo, which tradition links with Saturn.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on September 8?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On September 8 the Life Path is 6 in 1960, 7 in 1970, 8 in 1980, 9 in 1990, 1 in 2000, 2 in 2010 and 3 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 8 for everyone born on the 8th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on September 8?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by September 8, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on September 8?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on September 8 include Antonín Dvořák (1841), Bernie Sanders (1941) and Frédéric Mistral (1830). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
